The change targets the bank walk's locked-altar handling. The old `ring(locked_altars(), 0.8742)` only removed the locked altar tiles themselves, so safe tiles next to a locked altar stayed eligible as bank goals. The new version computes once per turn the safe ring tiles adjacent to unlocked altars, and `bank_t1` just picks the closest of those. This also removes a per-pass ring computation.

```python
@gene('v2', 'start of turn: block set once, then the rule, its goal and target; shared-memory and priority writes; open safe bank tiles once per turn')
def update() -> None:
    if not MAPPED:
        ALTAR_RING = altar_ring()
        SAFE_RING = safe_altar_ring()
        MONO_GROUPS = mono_groups()
        TERRAIN = walls() | holes() | altars() | enemy_spawn()
        BIG_CAMPS = type_spawns(MONOLITH) | type_spawns(GOLEM)
        CAMP_BASE = camp_spawns() - BIG_CAMPS - MONO_GROUPS
        SK0 = slot_kind(0)
        SK1 = slot_kind(1)
        MAPPED = True
    BLOCK = blocked_now()
    FREE_RING = SAFE_RING & ring(altars() - locked_altars(), 1.5)
    RULE = rule()
    GOAL = rule_goal()
    TGT = rule_target()
    OPEN = False
    if walks() and valid(GOAL) and GOAL != here():
        OPEN = walk_open()
        FIELD = walk_field()
    LOCK_BUY = RULE >= 1 and at_spawn() and wants_lock()
    if LOCK_BUY:
        write_shared(7, read_shared(7) + 2)
    SHOP_GOLD = gold() - (10 if LOCK_BUY else 0)
    if RULE == 8:
        write_shared(7, read_shared(7) + 1)
    if RULE == 20:
        set_priority(1 + rand(149))
```

```python
@gene("m13", "nearest tile next to a safe altar that no enemy lock blocks (open ring cached per turn in update)")
def bank_t1() -> Tile:
    return closest(FREE_RING)
```
